card.name: Ending of discontinuance and similar words
card.fires_on: The closing piece of a long word split into parts, most often "ance" in "discontinuance" in drug-label text. It also fires on pieces inside names like Luigi and Gianluigi, and in words like septuagenarians and linguistics.

modes.label: Discontinuance
modes.description: The "ance" ending of "discontinuance" before "of therapy" or "of the drug".

modes.label: Italian names
modes.description: The "igi" piece inside Italian first names such as Luigi and Gianluigi.

modes.label: Other long words
modes.description: A middle or end piece inside rare long words in general web text.

card.plain: It fires on the last piece of the word "discontinuance" and on pieces of a few other long or unusual words.
